claim: ChatGPT may use personal-account conversations to train its models, depending on your settings.
scope: US adult users of ChatGPT personal accounts; company-stated policy, with business and managed-account exclusions distinguished. Not a claim about all AI services.
time_horizon: Current stated practice as inspected October 6, 2026; no prediction of whether a particular conversation will enter a future model.

P1.reason: Current official policy directly supports eligibility for training. The claim does not assert that a particular conversation was selected or present an independently audited rate.

P2.claim_phrase: personal-account conversations … depending on your settings
P2.reason: Account scope is explicit. Policy distinguishes eligible consumer content from business services excluded by default, and preserves opt-out and feedback qualifications.

sources.locator: Does OpenAI train its models on my business data?

P3.reason: The training-use possibility is evidenced by an explicit eligibility pathway. No inevitable inclusion or timeline is asserted.

W1.claim_phrase: ChatGPT may use personal-account conversations to train its models, depending on your settings.
W1.reason: No sensational metaphor or guaranteed privacy reassurance is added to the factual possibility. This preserves the source occurrence’s conditional framing.

W2.reason: ChatGPT is ordinary shorthand for the provider’s service and training process. The claim does not attribute human intentions, feelings, or independent decisions to the model.

sources.locator: Opening explanation and What information may be used in training (retrieved lines 51–61)

evidence_limitations: The decisive sources establish company-stated practices, not an independent compliance audit or the frequency of actual training selection.
The evidence does not quantify personal exposure, misuse, or privacy incident probabilities. A low hype score is not a safety rating.
Other providers, third-party integrations, and every managed-workspace configuration are outside the scored scope; state rights are not nationwide rights.
Help Center update dates are relative as displayed on October 6, 2026; policies must be refreshed if publication is delayed.
review_status: AI evidence review completed; human editorial review pending
